We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id for the template that when applied to the molecule reproduces sulfonamide formation retrosynthetic step. Input from previous step: make_7_lvl2-apply_template-2 gave precursors list: [["CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1", "O=C(O)C=Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1"]]. So the target molecule is something that when applying template gave those two precursors. The target molecule likely is the product of sulfonamide formation: combine amine (the first precursor) with sulfonyl chloride (second precursor) to form sulfonamide. The product SMILES likely is: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C=C(C=O)O)cc1? Wait second precursor is O=C(O)C=Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1. That's a sulfonyl chloride attached to aromatic ring with a vinyl carboxylic acid side chain? Actually O=C(O)C=Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1 is a cinnamic acid derivative with sulfonyl chloride on phenyl. The amine precursor is CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1 (tert-butyl carbamate? Actually it's a protected amine: t-butyl carbamate attached to an aniline). The product would be the sulfonamide linking the nitrogen of the amine to the sulfonyl chloride, removing Cl and forming S-N bond. So product SMILES: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C=C(C=O)O)cc1? Wait the sulfonyl chloride part had S(=O)(=O)Cl attached to aromatic ring. After reaction, Cl replaced by N. So product: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccc(N)cc1S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C=C(C=O)O)cc1. That matches earlier attempt where we used that as molecule_smiles in search. Good.

Now we need to find template that matches this transformation. We can search by criteria: functional_groups_broken: "alkyl halide"? Actually sulfonyl chloride is a functional group "alkyl halide"? Not exactly. The functional group list includes "alkyl halide", "aryl halide", "halide". Sulfonyl chloride maybe considered "alkyl halide"? Not sure. Could use bonds broken: S-Cl bond broken, bonds formed: S-N bond formed. The bond format expects atomic numbers? The example "6-6" meaning bond between two atoms with atomic numbers? Actually likely bond types: "6-6" for C-C, "6-8" for C-O. So S is atomic number 16, N is 7, Cl is 17. So we used "16-17" broken, "16-7" formed earlier, got empty result. Maybe need to include also functional groups? Could search without criteria just limit.
